spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ws.timestamp AS "time",
  SUM(a.total_value_pln) AS "total_money"
FROM asset_snapshots a
JOIN portfolio_snapshots ps ON a.portfolio_snapshot_id = ps.id
JOIN wallet_snapshots ws ON ps.wallet_snapshot_id = ws.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.timestamp)
GROUP BY ws.timestamp
ORDER BY ws.timestamp ASC;

SELECT
  ws.timestamp AS "time",
  SUM(a.total_value_pln) AS "Cash"
FROM asset_snapshots a
JOIN portfolio_snapshots ps ON a.portfolio_snapshot_id = ps.id
JOIN wallet_snapshots ws ON ps.wallet_snapshot_id = ws.id
WHERE a.asset_type = 'Cash'
  AND $__timeFilter(ws.timestamp)
GROUP BY ws.timestamp
ORDER BY ws.timestamp ASC;

WITH daily_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ws.timestamp AS time,
    a.asset_type AS metric,
    SUM(a.total_value_pln) AS raw_value
  FROM asset_snapshots a
  JOIN portfolio_snapshots ps ON a.portfolio_snapshot_id = ps.id
  JOIN wallet_snapshots ws ON ps.wallet_snapshot_id = ws.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ws.timestamp)
  GROUP BY ws.timestamp, a.asset_type
)
SELECT
  time,
  metric,
  ROUND((raw_value / FIRST_VALUE(raw_value) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY time ASC)) * 100, 2) AS value
FROM daily_totals
ORDER BY time ASC;

SELECT 
  SUM(a.total_value_pln) AS "Total Money"
FROM asset_snapshots a
JOIN portfolio_snapshots ps ON a.portfolio_snapshot_id = ps.id
JOIN wallet_snapshots ws ON ps.wallet_snapshot_id = ws.id
WHERE ws.id = (
  SELECT MAX(id) 
  FROM wallet_snapshots
);

SELECT
  a.asset_type AS "Klasa Aktywów",
  ps.name AS "Portfel / Konto",
  SUM(a.total_value_pln) AS "Wartość (PLN)"
FROM asset_snapshots a
JOIN portfolio_snapshots ps ON a.portfolio_snapshot_id = ps.id
JOIN wallet_snapshots ws ON ps.wallet_snapshot_id = ws.id
WHERE ws.id = (
    -- Wybór wyłącznie ostatniego uruchomienia skryptu
    SELECT MAX(id) FROM wallet_snapshots
)
GROUP BY a.asset_type, ps.name
ORDER BY a.asset_type ASC, "Wartość (PLN)" DESC;

SELECT
  a.asset_type AS "Klasa Aktywów",
  SUM(a.total_value_pln) AS "Wartość (PLN)"
FROM asset_snapshots a
JOIN portfolio_snapshots ps ON a.portfolio_snapshot_id = ps.id
JOIN wallet_snapshots ws ON ps.wallet_snapshot_id = ws.id
WHERE ws.id = (
  SELECT MAX(id) 
  FROM wallet_snapshots
)
GROUP BY a.asset_type
ORDER BY "Wartość (PLN)" DESC;

SELECT
  ws.timestamp AS "time",
  a.total_value_pln AS "Gold",
  a.name AS "metric"
FROM asset_snapshots a
JOIN portfolio_snapshots ps ON a.portfolio_snapshot_id = ps.id
JOIN wallet_snapshots ws ON ps.wallet_snapshot_id = ws.id
WHERE a.asset_type = 'Gold'
  AND $__timeFilter(ws.timestamp)
ORDER BY ws.timestamp ASC;
